notes:
v4.6.45 — Fixes IBKR bot crash on every order ('unexpected keyword argument order_data')

🐛 FIXED — IBKR bots failed every buy/sell with 'submit_order() got an unexpected keyword argument order_data'
• The IBKR order adapter used the wrong parameter name, so every order the bot tried to place on IBKR crashed instantly. It now matches the standard order API, so IBKR orders go through.

⚠️ Note on IBKR + crypto: Interactive Brokers only offers a small set of cryptocurrencies (e.g. BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH). Coins it doesn't list — like ONDO — can't be traded on IBKR no matter what; you'll now see a clear 'could not qualify <symbol>' message instead of a crash. For wide crypto coverage, run your crypto bot on Alpaca; use IBKR for stocks (LONG / SHORT / DAY).

Update normally via the in-app banner. Restart any bot running on Oracle so it picks up the fix.
